split_pipe.dataset_id: String (The unique identifier for the dataset.)
split_pipe.sublibraries: Array[Sublibrary] (sublibrary_id + fastq_R1s + fastq_R2s; one entry per sublibrary)
split_pipe.genome_name: String (The name of the reference genome: 'hg38' or 'mm10'
split_pipe.genome_ref_tar_gz: File? (optional; prebuilt split-pipe mkref index. Supply to skip make_reference, omit to build one)
split_pipe.genome_fasta: File (only used when genome_ref_tar_gz is omitted)
split_pipe.genes_gtf: File (only used when genome_ref_tar_gz is omitted)
split_pipe.kit: String (Parse Bio kit versions: WT_mini, WT, WT_mega, WT_mega_384, WT_penta, WT_penta_384)
split_pipe.sample_list_tsv: File (sample name + round-1 wells, one per line)
